statement: The canonical maximal common quotient C of the mixed Fermat homology quotient J12 and T3=B/D9(K) has order2304*2^403 and coefficient kernel C4^69 plus C2^265. The exact D9 image is C4^51 plus C2^265. A new actual generating finite GT0 shadow exists on J12 fibre product over C with T3, of order2^13472*3^1156. Before the common gauge its T3 action is exactly D33; after gaugek=-774 it is Int(c0^258) times that action. The normalized G6 and J3 actions remain those of D37, while the J12 action is explicitly replaced. Its cubic Tate16 matrix is(3,8;8,11), its quartic Tate3 matrix isI, and the extra fixed-fibre CM pair remains T4=I,W3=[i]. Both projection kernels and the exact remaining full-source kernel are computed, with an explicit nonzero word [a1^12,a2^12]^2 in the latter. Full profinite realization remains unresolved.
